dev_environment: Development PC (Xeon + GTX 1070) without YuE2 or Seed-VC: stand-in runtime with FFmpeg 8.1.1 (with Rubber Band), Python 3.11, numpy/scipy/soundfile/librosa 0.11 and placeholder YuE2 files; a stand-in Seed-VC inference.py with the pinned interface runs under the real seedvc_runner.py.
test_environment_note: On a Chinese-locale Windows console, run the tests with PYTHONUTF8=1; otherwise test_voice.py's self-test reads the runner's Chinese stderr as GBK and errors (an environment issue that predates v1.6.0).
checks: Catalog: every one of 51 styles sits in exactly one group, has tags and a Chinese label, reaches build_caption / build_request (any letter case), and explicit requirements still replace the preset instrumentation; 20 distinct defaults keep v1.5.0's first ten.

Smart defaults: style mode / melody replace the shared choice, tempo / key fill only unchanged values (not linked speed), explicit per-song fields are never touched, kid +2 only where someone new sings, preserve keeps the reference melody; recorded per job; invalid switches or explicit lists reject the batch; forged smart_applied / suite_part in requests are stripped.

20 versions: settings, tracks and batches accept 1-20 (A-T); 10-entry lists saved by v1.5.0 (styles, notes, voice switches) are padded on read and on save; analysis is reused only between versions with the same mode and key/tempo.
Singers: kid, duet, choir and opera reach the request; kid, duet and choir drop voice swap; preserve and instrumental force the automatic singer, so the original recording is never changed.

Kid voice: octave plan from the median pitch; formants move while pYIN pitch stays (spectral warp), a low take moves one octave with Rubber Band or resampling and ends with +5 semitones of formant; remix keeps level and length; silent vocals are left untouched; pipeline order generate -> separate-generated -> kid -> validate; the notice is added to result.json.

DJ edits on synthetic beat tracks: filter intro muffles only the first 16 beats; the drop lands on the energy jump with half a beat of silence before it and leaves the rest bit-identical (after gain); echo-out cuts on a beat 8 beats before the end and rings 8 beats; the source WAV is never changed.

Non-stop mix with the real FFmpeg: tempos 120 / 126 / 62 fold to one mix tempo, every song beat-matched and loudness-evened, transitions exactly the chosen beats, output length = songs + transitions, no clipping; auto order follows tempo and Camelot distance; Krumhansl key finds C major / A minor.

Suite: onset-envelope alignment finds a 150-200 ms lag (and prefers the smallest shift among repeating beats), switch points land on the quiet moments near each third, the three parts play in turn at full length.

Service: DJ / mix / suite jobs run in the effects queue, carry names with all parent labels, expose their reports, never spawn speed versions, honour the queue limit and the 60-minute mix limit; the suite is queued exactly once when the third part completes, also after a restart.
browser_verified: Stand-in install refreshed to v1.6.0; the interface connects and reports v1.6.0; no console errors
Version count offers 1-20 (A-T); 'fill by style group' (Asian DJ) set A-T to 20 distinct styles and the server saved them; v1.5.0's stored 10-entry settings were padded
Grouped style dropdowns show Chinese labels; smart-default hints under each version (e.g. Vinahouse: keep original singer, tempo 115%)

Singer 'kid' shows its note and the voice-swap badge '童声不换声'; suite switch, its three part pickers and the per-song suite select work; footer and confirmation dialog count 2 versions + 3 suite parts + 1 suite

Confirmed batch: A/B (Manyao / Vinahouse) queued as keep-original-singer with tempo 105% / 115% and their smart defaults; C-E queued as kid-voice suite parts (reference melody, no speed versions, no voice swap) with D and E reusing C's analysis; test jobs removed afterwards
DJ effects dialog: three effects tick with real clicks, the name preview matches the server name; the DJ edit job rendered through the engine to a 29.7 s work

DJ mix: picking works on cards with order numbers and a sticky bar, the dialog reorders, sets 8 beats and a Chinese name; the mix job rendered through the engine (79.4 s) and shows in its own group with order and tempo in the details
375 px wide: no horizontal scroll on the studio page

Subjective listening: the new styles, the kid / duet / choir / opera singers and the kid voice step, smart-default DJ versions, a suite, DJ edits and a non-stop mix of real songs
validation_limitations: No real YuE2, UVR or Seed-VC inference was possible on the development PC; styles and singers are checked as request text only, the kid voice, DJ tools and suite on synthetic audio.
Whether YuE2 follows the new style, singer (child, duet, choir, opera) and rap requests is not known until listening on the app PC.
Beat and key detection use librosa on whole songs; songs with weak or changing beats may get imprecise drops, echoes, mix transitions or suite alignment.
Rubber Band's own formant keeping is not used: measured with FFmpeg 8.1.1 it holds only partly going up and not at all going down.
